pages.title: About Poder Emporium
pages.content:
## The Art of Bespoke Footwear & Comfort

Founded with a singular vision in Johannesburg, **Poder Emporium** represents the pinnacle of luxury footwear craftsmanship and bespoke leisure slippers in South Africa.

### Our Heritage & Craft
Every pair in our atelier is meticulously constructed using full-grain leathers, plush velvets, and anatomical cork footbeds. We blend time-honoured shoemaking techniques with contemporary silhouette engineering.

* **Ethically Sourced Leathers**: Hand-selected calfskins, suede, and shearling.
* **Goodyear Welt & Blake Stitching**: Providing structural longevity and resolability.
* **Comfort Engineering**: Multi-density memory foam footbeds for day-to-night luxury.

### Atelier & Flagship
Visit our private styling salon in Boksburg, Gauteng, by appointment or order securely online with nationwide tracked courier delivery.
pages.seoDescription: Discover the story, craftsmanship, and heritage behind Poder Emporium luxury footwear.

pages.title: Contact Us & Client Concierge
pages.content:

Have an enquiry regarding sizing, custom monograms, or shipping updates? Our client concierge is standing by to assist you.

pages.seoDescription: Reach our customer support team via WhatsApp, telephone or service and collection in Boksburg.

pages.title: Delivery & Nationwide Shipping
pages.content:
## Fast & Secure Nationwide Delivery

We partner with South Africa's premier courier networks (The Courier Guy, Dawn Wing, and DHL Express) to ensure your purchase arrives promptly and securely.

### Delivery Rates & Timelines
* **Standard Delivery (R99)**: 3–5 business days nationwide. Complimentary on orders over R1,200.
* **Gauteng Priority Delivery (R149)**: 1–2 business days.
* **Overnight Express Air (R199)**: Major metropolitan hubs (JHB, CPT, DBN, PLZ, BFN).
* **International DHL Express (R450)**: 4–7 business days.

All shipments are fully insured and include live SMS and email tracking links.
pages.seoDescription: Nationwide South African courier delivery rates, timelines, and tracking info.

pages.title: Returns & Size Exchanges
pages.content:
## Hassle-Free 14-Day Returns & Complimentary Size Exchanges

We want you to step into your new pair with absolute confidence.

### Size Exchanges
We offer **one complimentary size exchange** per order within South Africa. Simply contact our WhatsApp concierge (+27 71 804 1085) or email care@poderemporium.co.za and we will arrange courier collection from your doorstep.

### Return Conditions
1. Items must be unworn, in pristine original condition, and with all protective films, dust bags, and boxes intact.
2. Shoes must be tried on carpeted surfaces only to prevent scuff marks on leather soles.
3. Return requests must be initiated within 14 days of parcel delivery.
pages.seoDescription: Information on 14-day returns and complimentary size exchanges.

pages.title: Terms of Service
pages.content:
## Terms & Conditions of Sale

By accessing or making a purchase on Poder Emporium, you agree to the following terms and conditions governed by the laws of the Republic of South Africa.

### Pricing & Payments
All prices are displayed in South African Rand (ZAR) and are inclusive of 15% Value Added Tax (VAT) unless otherwise indicated. We accept secure payments through PayFast only.
pages.seoDescription: Legal terms and conditions governing purchases and site usage.

pages.title: Privacy & POPIA Compliance
pages.content:
## Protection of Personal Information (POPIA)

Poder Emporium is committed to safeguarding your privacy and processing your personal information in strict accordance with the South African Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA).

We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties under any circumstances.
pages.seoDescription: Learn how we protect your personal data in accordance with POPIA regulations.

pages.title: Bespoke Size & Fit Guide
pages.content:
## Footwear & Slipper Sizing Chart

Our shoes follow standard **UK / South African** sizing. If you are between sizes, we recommend sizing up for casual loafers and slippers, and sizing down for wholecut dress oxfords.

| UK / SA | EU | US Men | US Women | Foot Length (cm) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| UK 5 | 38 | 6.0 | 7.5 | 24.5 cm |
| UK 6 | 39 | 7.0 | 8.5 | 25.4 cm |
| UK 7 | 40 | 8.0 | 9.5 | 26.0 cm |
| UK 8 | 41 | 9.0 | 10.5 | 27.0 cm |
| UK 9 | 42 | 10.0 | 11.5 | 27.8 cm |
| UK 10 | 43 | 11.0 | 12.5 | 28.6 cm |
| UK 11 | 44 | 12.0 | 13.5 | 29.4 cm |
| UK 12 | 45 | 13.0 | 14.5 | 30.2 cm |
pages.seoDescription: Accurate UK, EU, and US size conversion chart for footwear and slippers.

products.name: Artisan Wholecut Oxford in Oxblood Calfskin
products.description:
Individually cut from a single flawless piece of Italian full-grain calfskin leather, the Wholecut Oxford represents the pinnacle of classical shoe artistry. Hand-burnished in Rosebank to achieve a deep, multidimensional oxblood patina with Goodyear-welted channeled leather soles.

### Features
* **Upper**: Full-Grain Hand-Polished Italian Calfskin
* **Lining**: Soft Natural Glove Leather with Moisture-wicking property
* **Sole**: Traditional Goodyear-Welted Leather Sole with inset rubber heel tap
* **Craftsmanship**: 180 distinct hand-executed steps per pair
* **Packaging**: Includes wooden cedar shoe horns, dust bags, and conditioning cream
products.shortDescription: Handcrafted single-piece wholecut oxford in radiant oxblood Italian calfskin with Goodyear-welted leather soles.
